name: Result

sections.heading: Origin and explicit import
sections.text: Implicit origin: PRELUDE. Original module: std.core. Explicit alternative: import "std.core" { Result; }.explicit; --no-prelude removes implicit visibility. Import every referenced prelude name explicitly; imports grant no capability.

sections.heading: Behavior, methods and protocols
sections.text: isOk/isErr distinguish variants. get/expect observe Ok; getErr/expectErr require Err. The measured value-form map(43), mapErr(47), andThen(Ok(53)) and orElse(Ok(61)) preserve the selected payload type; arbitrary effectful callbacks are not implied.

sections.heading: Ownership and effects
sections.text: Owns the active T or E. Propagation selects the active error route and does not implicitly discard live resources.

sections.heading: Errors and limits
sections.text: Wrong-side observers and incompatible fallback/callback types reject in the bounded profile. Imported metadata cannot supply executable payloads.

summary: A typed success or failure with one active payload.
title: std.prelude.Result
